name: Camping Natterersee
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Natterersee is located in the municipality of Natters southwest of Innsbruck. The site is located directly on the Natterersee, which invites swimming in summer and ice skating in winter. The facility offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans as well as rental accommodation in the form of mobile homes. A restaurant with regional cuisine and a kiosk are available on the premises. From here, excursions to Innsbruck with its old town and its cultural institutions are easily possible. The surrounding mountains offer opportunities for hiking and ski tours all year round.
